caption: What if you threw a samosa through time and it landed 66 million years ago, at the very end of the age of dinosaurs? A T. rex would probably smell it first. Scientists think it had one of the strongest senses of smell of any dinosaur, but its arms were famously tiny. A Triceratops, a plant-eater, might be the one to actually take a bite. Fun fact: the potatoes inside didn't exist yet, and the samosa itself only reached India a few centuries ago, travelling with traders from Central Asia and the Middle East. Then a roughly 10 km wide asteroid hits Earth and the age of the dinosaurs ends. Millions of years later, someone digs up a very strange fossil... What would YOU send back in time? 👇
